## Summary

Describe the behavior change and its user impact.

## Safety and evidence

- [ ] I preserved the advisory, bounded, redacted, offline-by-default boundaries.
- [ ] I added normal and fail-closed tests or explain why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I ran the relevant verification commands.
- [ ] I added a Changeset when this changes a published package.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, customer data, or machine-specific paths.
